entities.name: Valery Vakulčyk
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Valery Pavlovich Vakulchik is a Belarusian civil servant and soldier. He was the Chairman of State Security Committee of the Republic of Belarus from November 16, 2012, to September 3, 2020. Vakulchik was also Secretary of the State Security Council of the Republic of Belarus from September 3, 2020, to October 29, 2020.
